answer_1.quote: We fine-tune large language models to translate from textual chart representations to natural language captions...
answer_1.outputs: Semantically rich chart captions (natural language descriptions of the visualized data)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate each model using machine translation and text generation metrics, including BLEU, Perplexity, Relation Generation (RG), ROUGE, Word Mover's Distance (WMD), and Translational Error Rate (TER).

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 176 generated captions from the scene‑graph model with prefix‑tuning and break them into their independent L2 and L3 statements... Approximately half of the statements are factually accurate.
answer_4.guideline: Captions are broken into independent L2/L3 statements and assessed for factual correctness and descriptiveness.
